title: "Research"
description: "Research themes."
---

<p class="lead">My research asks how democratic values are carried, transformed, and contested through public administration and public policy.</p>

<div class="research-grid">

<section>
<h2>Democratic governance</h2>
<p>I study the relationship between public administration and representative government, with particular attention to discretion, legitimacy, accountability, and the institutional design of public power.</p>
</section>

<section>
<h2>Public values and administration</h2>
<p>Recent work examines how values such as accountability, impartiality, legality, efficiency, participation, transparency, responsiveness, equality, and integrity are embedded in administrative institutions and public belief systems.</p>
</section>

<section>
<h2>Policy design and statecraft</h2>
<p>I have written on public policy investment, policy agendas, public-private partnerships, and the ways governments prioritize, structure, and justify policy commitments.</p>
</section>

<section>
<h2>Text, institutions, and evidence</h2>
<p>Current work uses qualitative analysis, formal theory, surveys, experiments, and machine learning to examine how institutions express and reinforce democratic values.</p>
</section>

</div>
